plan.quantity: 100 mainboard / 200 STAR shares; BUY and SELL independently; sell assumes sufficient initial sellable inventory per task
plan.protection: fixed initial opposite best +/-2 cents, minimum1 cent
plan.latency: signal observation at clock t; entire cancel/replace or submit action effective at t+delay; prior order may fill meanwhile; size recomputed at effectiveness; final action pre-scheduled to become effective at deadline. Idealized atomic replace, no extra ACK/return latency or market-data lag.
plan.evaluation: all tasks with actual fills/fees plus separately marked unfilled opportunity cost at deadline midpoint; paired all-completed subset secondary; no portfolio/roundtrip profit claim
plan.selection: all stocks/all regular30-second origins with full30-second window strictly inside same session; no outcome selection, no retuning; single previously studied day, not out of sample

uncertainty: 1000 crossed stock/10-minute common-clock-block bootstrap; within-day only, no new-day validation
money_note: Arithmetic savings/marks across independent task scenarios; not one funded portfolio, not daily realized profit. End marks use deadline midpoint without hypothetical liquidation/exit fees.
exploratory_valuation_sensitivity: Added after inspecting primary results: assign remaining quantity one additional child fee at deadline midpoint. Not extra fills, not actual completion, and no spread/impact or protection constraints modeled for that hypothetical completion.
